title: Wendell and the Harbor
author: Silas Dravenmoor
blurb: Juniper Yarrow, an apprentice clockmaker summoned to repair the observatory's master clock, measures the world in what can be carried when the orders come. But when a sealed letter names the family in a plot no one wants a part of, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must get the truth on the record ahead of the victors' historians before the century turns.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
